parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 standby address-.template: set interfaces [parameter1] standby address-family inet master-address [parameter2] backup-address [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 standby address-.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 standby address-family inet master-address 192.168.1.1 backup-address 192.168.1.2
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 standby address-.explanation: 配置接口的备用地址族，指定主地址和备用地址。

parameters.name: backup-address
parameters.explanation: 备用地址，用于主备切换。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set chassis slot 1 redundancy-group 1 pr.explanation: 配置机箱插槽的冗余组优先级。

parameters.name: priority
parameters.explanation: 优先级，用于决定主备切换的顺序。

set routing-options router ospf 1 area 0.template: set routing-options router ospf [parameter1] area [parameter2] network [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set routing-options router ospf 1 area 0.command: set routing-options router ospf 1 area 0 network 192.168.1.0/255.255.255.0
set routing-options router ospf 1 area 0.explanation: 配置OSPF路由协议的区域网络。

set routing-options router ospf 1 area 0.template: set routing-options router ospf [parameter1] area [parameter2] network [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set routing-options router ospf 1 area 0.command: set routing-options router ospf 1 area 0 network 10.1.1.0/255.255.255.0
set routing-options router ospf 1 area 0.explanation: 配置OSPF路由协议的区域网络。
